usefulness.rationale: The reader gets a clear identity anchor (full name, birth, role, succession from Naik, education) and a picture of L&T's digital/AI direction under him, but everything substantive rests on a single article, and the dossier never says what it does not know — the two 'contested' flags come with no explanation of what is uncertain. Enough to prepare for a meeting on L&T's AI strategy, but not to assess his personal role versus company output. The two unjustified conclusions already flagged (naik-successor-authority, safety-outcomes) are not repeated in the dossier statements, so no new overclaims match them; instead two dossier claims overstate their cited passage.
